_note: Damage-relevant numeric models of runes, from data/runes.json descriptions. levelRange [lo,hi] interpolates over levels 1->15. bonusAd folds into total AD; burstProc = one-time damage in the combo (flat + adRatio*bonusAD + apRatio*AP); onHit = per-auto bonus; ampPct = % combo damage amp. PoC scope: Graves-relevant runes.

Phase Rush._why: melee 40%/60% MS + 25 haste on 3-hit proc; ~60% fight uptime of the 40% roll

Coup de Grace.note: vs targets <40% HP (approx: applied to kill combo)

Last Stand.note: only when YOU are <60% HP — 0 for burst-from-full

Celerity._why: 2% MS; all MS bonuses on you increased 7%

Nimbus Cloak._why: 10-40% MS for 3s on summoner cast; avg fight uptime approximation

Gathering Storm._why: scaling AD by game time, ~15min value (8 ad x2? use 16 approximation)
